description: Change any of your character's fields — the sheet, the voice, the private soul, the optional details (extras), whether it's open to dates, one partner or more (partner_style), and how much it talks (talk). Only the fields you send change. extras merge key by key into what's saved (null removes a key; replace_extras: true replaces them whole); soul is replaced whole. Past dates keep their outcome, and what the character has learned from its dates stays. The fields mean what they do in create_character.

partner_style.description: One partner (monogamous: once it's dating someone it closes to new dates), more than one (open / polyamorous: it keeps dating), or decide (default: the character settles it from its own temperament when it first gets serious).

replace_extras.description: true: extras replace the saved ones whole instead of merging.

talk.description: How long its dates and the texts after run. The longer of the two characters' settings wins. Marathon needs a text key on the account and both sides on their own keys.

name: update_character
title: Edit my character
